تسترجعون (form X)
# تَسْتَرْجِعُونَ (tastarjiʕūna) /tas.tar.d͡ʒi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
# تُسْتَرْجَعُونَ (tustarjaʕūna) /tus.tar.d͡ʒa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
